# Architeq Web Agency

> Gauteng-based web agency building lead-generating websites for South African home-services and local businesses. Fixed-price builds delivered in 7 days (average 5).

Architeq designs and develops websites, custom email setups, SaaS/MVP products, and custom internal software. All starting prices are in ZAR and end in 999+ (e.g. R2,000+, R5,000+). Website care plans start at R300/month and include hosting.
